name: Tremor
summary: React + Tailwind components for dashboards and charts; free npm core, paid blocks separate.
gaps: Freemium: free @tremor/react + open-source Raw on tremor.so; paid Tremor Blocks/templates excluded from this ingest.
Pilot includes 12 free npm comps of 20+ open-source set — not the 250+ paid blocks.
Requires Tailwind CSS configuration (content path must include @tremor).
Copy-paste Tremor Raw (tremor.so) is an alternate free surface; this packet uses NPM package demos.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.
